project_name: SOLEKICKS PK - Premium Editorial Sneaker & Streetwear E-Commerce

design_philosophy.concept: Tactical Editorial Brutalism for Sneaker Culture
design_philosophy.summary: Transforms SOLEKICKS PK from a generic SaaS-like interface into a confident, high-contrast, editorial streetwear powerhouse. Eliminates all rounded-full pill buttons and rounded-2xl bubbly cards in favor of razor-sharp architectural geometry (0px to 2px radii), stark obsidian-and-white tonal tension, disciplined 8px spacing, and surgical red-orange (#FF3B30) kinetic accents used strictly for high-converting triggers.
design_philosophy.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & HIGH-FASHION EDITORIAL
core_tenets: Sharp & Architectural: 0px to 2px corner radius across all interactive elements and surfaces. Zero pill buttons.
High-Contrast Tension: Pure Obsidian (#0A0A0A) against Crisp White (#FAFAFA / #FFFFFF) with subtle 1px structural gridlines (#E5E7EB / #27272A).
Surgical Accent Trigger: Fire Red-Orange (#FF3B30) restricted to sale badges, primary cart actions, live stock urgency, and active nav states (< 5% surface area).
Editorial Grotesk Typography: Heavyweight condensed Archivo/Grotesk headings with tight letter-spacing, paired with ultra-legible Inter body and JetBrains Mono data/prices.
Tactile Motion: Smooth image swaps, subtle 1px border hover blooms, sliding canvas drawers, zero disruptive global transitions.
anti_patterns_strictly_forbidden: NO rounded-full pill buttons or pill category chips
NO rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl bubbly container cards
NO soft colored drop shadows or neon glow halos
NO glassmorphism blur over text that hampers legibility
NO centered text in app container (.App { text-align: center; })

obsidian_primary.usage: Dominant near-black anchor for headers, primary buttons, footer, flash sale backdrops, heavy typography, and high-contrast frames.

canvas_background.usage: Crisp off-white foundational background providing clean editorial breathing room.

surface_white.usage: Product card containers, modal interiors, drawer sheets, and data surfaces.

kinetic_fire_accent.usage: STRICTLY SPARING: Discount/Sale badges, primary checkout & add-to-bag triggers, low stock urgency notices, active tab underlines, price emphasis.

contrast_rules.fire_on_white: text-[#FF3B30] on white for prices meets WCAG AA 4.5:1
contrast_rules.white_on_fire: text-white font-bold on #FF3B30 background for badges

corner_radius_scale.philosophy: Strict architectural precision. All previous rounded-full and rounded-2xl elements are replaced with 0px (rounded-none) or max 2px (rounded-sm) for a bespoke luxury streetwear look.

Header.description: Sticky shrinking header with top announcement marquee bar. High-contrast obsidian marquee, crystal glass white nav with 1px bottom border on scroll. Sharp icon action buttons without round pills.
key_elements: AnnouncementBar: bg-obsidian text-white py-2 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em]
Logo: SOLEKICKS.PK with sharp dot and mono country badge
Nav Links: font-display font-bold text-xs sm:text-[13px] uppercase tracking-wider relative hover:text-fire with underline-grow indicator
Action Buttons: Search, Wishlist, Account, Cart Drawer in sharp 10x10 squares with badge count counters
Mobile Menu: Full-height sliding panel with sharp borders and clean typography

HeroSlider.description: 75vh editorial banner slider. Deep obsidian base with 40-50% gradient scrim to preserve shoe photography. Confident 4xl-6xl Archivo headline, sharp rectangular 'SHOP DROP' action button, and minimalist horizontal progress tick bars.
key_elements: Image Overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-obsidian/90 via-obsidian/45 to-transparent (allows sneakers to breathe)
Typography: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight
CTA Button: bg-white text-obsidian rounded-none font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 hover:bg-fire hover:text-white
Slider Indicators: Sharp rectangular bars at bottom (h-1 w-10 vs w-3)

CategoryGrid.description: Asymmetric editorial drop grid with 1px borders and deep contrast overlays.
key_elements: Cards: aspect-[3/4] overflow-hidden rounded-none border border-ink-200 group relative
Hover Effect: Subtle 1.06x zoom with smooth darkening overlay
Typography: Sharp overline product count, heavy uppercase category name, and animated arrow link

FlashSaleSection.description: High-urgency obsidian block with fire countdown clock and sharp white product cards.
key_elements: Container: bg-obsidian text-white py-16 sm:py-24 border-y border-neutral-800
Countdown Timer: Sharp square mono tiles with white borders (bg-obsidian border border-neutral-700 text-white p-3 font-mono text-xl font-bold)
Cards: White sharp product cards on dark canvas creating intense graphic contrast

ProductCard.description: The centerpiece of the e-commerce catalog. Pure 0px radius, 1px subtle border, smooth hover image crossfade, sharp quick-add tray, and crisp price typography.
key_elements: Sharp border: border border-ink-200 hover:border-obsidian bg-white
Sharp badges: Sale (-XX%) in #FF3B30 and NEW in #0A0A0A (rounded-none)
Wishlist: Sharp square action trigger (rounded-none border border-ink-200)
Size Chips: Sharp mono squares (rounded-none border border-ink-200)
Quick Add: Full-width obsidian button with hover to fire transition

CartDrawer.description: Sliding right drawer with sharp geometry, free nationwide delivery milestone bar, item cards with sharp 1px borders, and high-impact checkout CTA.
key_elements: Drawer Panel: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-full sm:w-[440px] bg-[#FAFAFA] rounded-none border-l border-ink-200 shadow-2xl z-50
Free Shipping Bar: Sharp rectangular progress bar (h-2 bg-ink-200 rounded-none with bg-fire fill)
Item Rows: Sharp square product thumbnail, quantity minus/plus in sharp boxed grid
Checkout CTA: Full-width obsidian button (rounded-none py-4 hover:bg-fire)

ProductDetail.description: Editorial 2-column sneaker deep-dive. Sticky multi-image gallery with sharp thumbnail selectors, clear size grid with live low-stock badges, instant add-to-bag with COD trust cards, and tabbed specifications.
key_elements: Gallery: Sharp square master preview (rounded-none border border-ink-200 bg-[#F4F4F5]) + sharp thumbnail row with active fire border
Price Block: Large mono fire price + strikethrough original + sharp discount pill replacement
Size Selector: 8-column sharp grid of EU sizes with sold-out strikethrough and urgency counters
Trust Badges: 3 sharp square cards with COD, 7-day exchange, and authenticity guarantees
Tabs: Sharp underline tab switcher for Specs vs Customer Reviews

Checkout.description: Streamlined guest-friendly checkout with sharp form inputs, payment option selector cards, and sticky order summary.
key_elements: Form Fields: Sharp border-ink-200 inputs with focus:border-obsidian (rounded-none px-4 py-3)
Payment Tiles: 3 sharp cards (COD, Wallet/JazzCash/EasyPaisa, Card) with checkmark highlight
Order Summary: Sharp white card with 1px border, coupon input, store credit checkbox, and total breakdown

AdminDashboard.description: High-density command center with sharp obsidian sidebar, data cards, Recharts visualizations with #FF3B30 highlights, order status selectors, product form with multi-image reorder, and refund modals.
key_elements: Sidebar: Sharp obsidian vertical rail with fire active states
KPI Cards: Sharp 1px border white containers with mono metrics
Tables: Bordered dense tables with monospace order numbers and phone links
Modals: Sharp white center overlays with 1px borders (rounded-none)

Footer.description: High-impact near-black footer (#0A0A0A) with TrustRibbon banner, newsletter subscribe with sharp inputs, navigation links, and payment method chips.
key_elements: Trust Ribbon: 4-column white bar with nationwide delivery, 7-day exchange, authenticity, and WhatsApp support
Newsletter Form: Sharp bg-white/10 input + sharp fire submit button
Payment Badges: Sharp mono chips for COD, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Visa, Mastercard

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly honor all existing data-testid attributes and API integrations without altering endpoints or parameters.
Replace all instances of 'rounded-full' on buttons and category chips with 'rounded-none' for the sharp editorial aesthetic.
Replace all 'rounded-2xl' or 'rounded-3xl' containers with 'rounded-none' or subtle 'rounded-sm' bordered boxes.
Ensure the sticky header uses a solid/semi-solid crystal glass background ('bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-ink-200') to prevent transparent text overlap during scroll.
Use the Fire Red-Orange (#FF3B30) accent strictly for sale badges, live urgency stock notices, active indicators, and high-conversion actions (< 5% screen presence).
Preserve all responsive mobile workflows including the fixed bottom mobile navigation bar and sticky PDP mobile buy tray.
Keep framer-motion micro-animations smooth and lightweight; avoid 'transition: all' in CSS utilities.
